### Key Risks

- **Heavy sedation and grogginess:** Extreme drowsiness, confusion, and lingering next-day fogginess.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)
- **Impaired coordination and judgment:** Higher risk of dizziness, falls, accidents, or sleep-related behaviors.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15DQzrm2vdJGBcS8W0iU0jedaYAtu0sHfMLCzBkUEI7SFKb2VPUvtPSQ2nvX1QKkBX5mq5TnWzDrzHcVP6L3xecrdEbUmSlM_GteKGmS9fHI06ioua8Q3PLdwBQuwTVs_M8GUUnnAUM7ROClMeDJa6VnZO6l8iqanjUZbaa-sQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXtpViz-vD8tH0U7nSUEFX_-VsiHssrfsiBcK83XA0MfikmWD7gQTveyc1MJa0XLQzPu4pqBerPcHIYkVSc6mkyJ7I3Y_70bFT4D8Egi8BvwNl7n87tl2cSwFK-jvKbgFy14TDkkKBzPyRH0vYxUuuafhTFI_QTQ)
- **Slowed breathing:** Severe central nervous system depression can slow breathing, especially in older adults, people with sleep apnea, or those taking other sedating medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXyOGhv3rNmqlz0hthOnq_ERw6cFUeN69x0h-yVGYJTT4o9U_syCS8drfCu6NDVGpXHKfXzJ4FRlAz741gDDzLau39ZZLAoPXR745GCmyZhT8LxGqPyXkLLrcYUQvTILTTgCRZf58fSPk6nLU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ)
- **Worse sleep quality:** Alcohol disrupts sleep stages and reduces restorative rest even if it makes you feel sleepy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXhGHKtLbQj341c-6UnojibXLdrpmxOY4hiMiTFnXMl6mjOhmwnJFJ8DQuNFXhfkD99mDX1N3SknEQAXWI4osMVWaLqm3nd1Kx_cMP90Ws0-_KCFIfTKzD-QNh3IoEd1IwrYAfzRba)

### Safer Practices

- **Choose one or the other:** Skip Unisom if you have been drinking alcohol, and avoid alcohol while using it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ)
- **Allow a full rest window:** Plan for 7 to 8 hours of sleep after taking Unisom, and avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel drowsy the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX6iB0vIVfdEVMR91MAYC1BXTEodx1jaKlcpAMJyO7dMORhtpvyrX_dBwa0CCxCc-bHlfq1CypA8iJyV3JJ4MwXFaSKUn_wHH1EgFasOsH2jIyYfmKwneXwho-FqD8KG2OLJ3HzYwXDrC_1DZIk4gyVtga_N5RBuNL6D8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF17fPmzJ5j7mtHKQ87fmH7SaPx1wca8tOOx0yfaIVR2c3TwVUusVnknxNn2nuPHl5ytQLXToylf1CTjfDlaMVbdkNpX-3N4zJd5g52XCJxvRErrcAshAXMffgE3_8k6qlcKSf4asNfkCoXtzGeaVGTnADn--f1-wtDKaUEESzTTXHyYma)
- **Seek urgent care if needed:** Get immediate medical help if you or someone else experiences trouble breathing, extreme confusion, fainting, or difficulty waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXyOGhv3rNmqlz0hthOnq_ERw6cFUeN69x0h-yVGYJTT4o9U_syCS8drfCu6NDVGpXHKfXzJ4FRlAz741gDDzLau39ZZLAoPXR745GCmyZhT8LxGqPyXkLLrcYUQvTILTTgCRZf58fSPk6nLU)

You can review interaction details on [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15DQzrm2vdJGBcS8W0iU0jedaYAtu0sHfMLCzBkUEI7SFKb2VPUvtPSQ2nvX1QKkBX5mq5TnWzDrzHcVP6L3xecrdEbUmSlM_GteKGmS9fHI06ioua8Q3PLdwBQuwTVs_M8GUUnnAUM7ROClMeDJa6VnZO6l8iqanjUZbaa-sQ) or read more about mixing doxylamine and alcohol on [Ubie Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ) . If you or someone you know is struggling with combining alcohol and sleep aids, support and treatment options are available through [The Recovery Village](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXtpViz-vD8tH0U7nSUEFX_-VsiHssrfsiBcK83XA0MfikmWD7gQTveyc1MJa0XLQzPu4pqBerPcHIYkVSc6mkyJ7I3Y_70bFT4D8Egi8BvwNl7n87tl2cSwFK-jvKbgFy14TDkkKBzPyRH0vYxUuuafhTFI_QTQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF15DQzrm2vdJGBcS8W0iU0jedaYAtu0sHfMLCzBkUEI7SFKb2VPUvtPSQ2nvX1QKkBX5mq5TnWzDrzHcVP6L3xecrdEbUmSlM_GteKGmS9fHI06ioua8Q3PLdwBQuwTVs_M8GUUnnAUM7ROClMeDJa6VnZO6l8iqanjUZbaa-sQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1zDctlKnu0E0hIPviiglLY-F0YAfXSCxQZ8BN8gsGSzEpYTQaYxdBU4gvLgPdCdYgPiEgR-xOk0tmg2ll-ytzYr9dnwoTx-nSeY5yf_zh6Rwojx2YqNeBt1Cx3FB2JY9QOYTR_DPpZ6RM1jBFzdehgpfdZs5oiTsRU4rHwFR6nWxtcWmef35EOHyuCPlLzcDgQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXtpViz-vD8tH0U7nSUEFX_-VsiHssrfsiBcK83XA0MfikmWD7gQTveyc1MJa0XLQzPu4pqBerPcHIYkVSc6mkyJ7I3Y_70bFT4D8Egi8BvwNl7n87tl2cSwFK-jvKbgFy14TDkkKBzPyRH0vYxUuuafhTFI_QTQ)Are you asking because you **already combined** them tonight, or are you **planning** how to manage sleep? items.text: Choose one or the other: Skip Unisom if you have been drinking alcohol, and avoid alcohol while using it. Allow a full rest window: Plan for 7 to 8 hours of sleep after taking Unisom, and avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel drowsy the next day.
